## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `84c9eec38eba672e0bf092cef29bad0e5e6e02e1` · 2026-11-24T19:27Z

Card #37010.

- **Shape.** 3 files (+182/−3): `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`, one new test file, one changeset (`@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`). Not governed; no contract face (no spec, schema, skill or public export touched).
- **Fix, read against the code.** In `buildMobileCardRenderer`, when the object's declared name field is a `formula`, its `expression` reads are collected with `collectPredicateFieldRefs` (`ui/packages/core/src/utils/predicate-fields.ts:202`, already a dependency and the reader this grid's projection uses for CEL reads; an absent expression is skipped by `predicateSource`), and the subtitle filter drops every shown column in that set before taking two. A lookup read (`record.account.name`) names the lookup, so its column is skipped too. A non-formula name field yields an empty set, so the card is unchanged there. Status chip and amount line untouched.
- **Seat decision recorded in the body:** the reader is `collectPredicateFieldRefs`, not `@objectstack/formula`'s AST reader (option A, no new dependency); the two differ only on spellings a name formula does not use, and a difference can only skip a column, never draw a wrong value. Accepted.
- **Tests.** Three cases through the real `ObjectGrid` card at 375 px: formula title over the leading columns, formula column also shown, and a text-name-field control. Ablating the `titleReads` filter turns the two formula cases red with the filed defect text; restored blob-equal. Package vitest 2763 passed, type-check exit 0.
- **Accepted note:** when every shown body column is one the title reads, the subtitle is shorter or empty — the title already carries those values; not a defect.
- **Gates.** Check-runs at this head: 40 success, 13 expected skip (UI-only head), 0 failed, 0 pending. Landing K: counted by hand (UI-only head), 5 first-parent commits on main since the merge base `159113f4fe`.
- No must-fix, no should-fix.
